## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach taken.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests do not download real model weights or rely on private media.
- [ ] New behavior has tests, or the reason tests are not practical is explained.
- [ ] Windows/macOS implications have been considered.
- [ ] Documentation and the changelog are updated when user-visible behavior changes.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or unlicensed media are included.
- [ ] Third-party licenses are compatible with the proposed change.

## Screenshots or logs

Use synthetic or non-sensitive examples. Redact local paths, usernames, tokens, and other private information.
